comparison.objective: Measure two leveled scoops of powdered formula into a bottle.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular scooping, strike-off leveling, narrow-neck pouring, and spill control.
comparison.success_condition: Each scoop leveled at the bar; correct final mass; under 1 g spill; scoop released.
comparison.reason: Granular dosing and mass control are meaningfully different from coaxial mandrel placement, hammering, fracture, and metal-fragment recovery.
